title: Using the Sela Site Assurance Tool
description: Short online course on using the Sela site assurance tool: signing in, installing the Site Check app, completing a Sela Site Assurance Assessment (SELA-FRM-2026-001) on site, and following up reports and corrective actions in the assurance register. Includes 12 months of the Sela site assurance app (Full licence): $150 + GST for the first year, then $250 + GST a year. Prerequisite: completion of NZGTTM-SA-01 TTM Site Assurance Assessor.
